rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=40, recon_eta=30.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=120, train_n=0, rationale=iter-5 search-20260619-01 CONSTRAINED diff-recon. ONE HYPOTHESIS KNOB: recon_sample_steps 28->40 (the DDIM reverse-step count T); val_n 214->120 is the BUDGET-SIZING mechanism (box 5), NOT a hypothesis variable. BASE = iter-4 BEST (eta=30.0, relax=1.0, every5/n_cg3/warmup5, T=28). TRAJECTORY (val=214 L277, 321px FOV, LD-FBP floor ~0.81): iter-1 T=25 SSIM 0.3937/hr0/PSNR14.31; iter-2 eta30->1 -> 0.2366 (REGRESSED, wrong lever); iter-3 relax1.0->0.3 -> 0.2377 (flat, wrong lever); iter-4 T25->28 -> 0.4784/PSNR16.89 (BEST). KEY SIGNAL the iter-4 author under-weighted: T25->T28 MOVED SSIM +0.085 (0.394->0.478) and PSNR +2.6dB (14.3->16.9) MONOTONICALLY -> T is the ONLY live lever and the 25-28 step DDIM schedule is too COARSE for the constrained hard-DC trajectory to converge; eta+relax are exhausted (both regressed when moved off iter-1s working point). The recon sits 0.48 vs the 0.81 FBP floor i.e. the coarse reverse schedule + every-5 hard-DC re-noising is destroying the FBP init faster than it refines it; MORE reverse steps = finer schedule = less per-step corruption. iter-4 was budget-pinned at T=28 (1162.5s=19.4min at val_n=214, the 20-min wall) so it could not push T further; I unlock the T test by sizing val_n to 120 evenly-spaced (protocol-sanctioned: metric evenly-spaces across the 214-slice volume when val_n<214). HYPOTHESIS: if the T25->T28 climb (+0.085 SSIM / +2.6 dB per +3 steps) continues, T=40 lifts SSIM to ~0.55-0.65 (a clear monotone continuation toward the floor). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays <=0.50 (flat vs iter-4 0.478) at T=40, T has SATURATED -> the eta, relax AND T levers are ALL exhausted -> FILE THE DIFFUSION-PRIOR-MISMATCH VERDICT (Mayo v4 DDPM globally faithful but not conditionally faithful under DPS/DC, mirroring the breast-DDPM hr=0 structural verdict); constrained best stays iter-4 (SSIM 0.478, hr 0). BUDGET: cost linear in T x val_n. Per-slice-per-step constant = 0.193 s (iter-1 1019s/214/25=0.1904; iter-4 1162.5s/214/28=0.194). T=40 x val_n=120 = 40*120*0.193 = 926 s = 15.4 min < 20-min HARD wall (1800s in-solver backstop + 30-min --time further backstops). T=40 at full val_n=214 would be 1652s=27.5min (BLOWS the wall) -> val_n=120 is the budget mechanism that lets T climb. val=120 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False).
